                                           BOARD OF DIRECTORS MEETING
                                               NOTICE AND AGENDA

Date: February 18, 2026
Time: 9:00 AM
Place: Board Room, Tahoe-Truckee Sanitation Agency, 13720 Butterfield Drive, Truckee, California


The Board will accept public comments on any item on the agenda until the close of the public comment period. These comments
final mail collection before the meeting will be the Monday before the meeting at 3:00 p.m.). Members of the public will have the
opportunity to directly address the Agency Board of Directors concerning any item listed on the Agenda below before or during
consideration of that item. To better accommodate members of the public and staff, some Agenda items may be considered in an
order different from those listed below.


I.     Call to Order, Roll Call, and Pledge of Allegiance
       At this time, please silence phones and other electronic devices so as not to disrupt the business of the
       meeting.
II.    Public Comment
       This time is reserved for members of the public to address the Board on items not listed on the agenda.
       Speakers must state their name for the record and are limited to five (5) minutes. The Board cannot take
       action on non-agenda items but may acknowledge comments, provide brief responses, refer matters to staff,
       or schedule them for future consideration. Written statements may be submitted to the Board Clerk for
       inclusion in the official record.
III.   Review and Adopt Agenda
       1.    Review and Approval to Adopt the Agenda.
IV.    Professional Achievements, Awards, Anniversaries, and Staff Acknowledgments
       1.    Professional Achievements, Anniversaries, and Promotions.

V.     Consent Agenda
       The Consent Agenda consists of routine items for which Board approval can be taken with a single motion
       and vote. A Board Member may request that any item be placed on the Regular Agenda for separate
       consideration.
       1.    Review and Approval of the Regular Board Meeting Minutes from December 17, 2025.
       2.    Ratification of the Approval of the General Fund Warrants paid in December 2025 and January 2026.

VI.    Regular Agenda
       1.    Informational Update on the Agency Bond Issuance.
       2.    Information and Discussion on the Agency Quarterly Financial Plan Update.
       3.    Approval of the Network Upgrades Project Engineering Design Contract
       4.    Information and Discussion on Capital Improvement Plan
       5.    Placer County LAFCO Commission "Call for Nominations" to Fill One Regular Special District
             Representative Seat for the 2026-2030 Term.

6.     Department Reports: Informational Updates for the Board of Directors
              a.    Operations Department Report
              b.    Maintenance Department Report
              c.    Technical Services Department Report
              d.    Administration Department Report
       7.     General Manager Report: Informational Updates for the Board of Directors.

VII.   Board of Directors Comment
       1.     Board of Directors Comment.

VIII. Closed Session
       1.     Closed Session for (a) Public Employee Performance Evaluation of the General Manager (Government
              Code §54954.5).
       2.     Report from Closed Session.

IX.    Adjournment


                                                Posted and Mailed: February 12, 2026.


                                                Roshelle Chavez
                                                Executive Assistant/Board Clerk

In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act, if you are a disabled person and need a disability-related modification or
accommodation to participate in this meeting, please email Roshelle Chavez or call 530-587-2525. Requests must be made as early
as possible and at least one full business day before the start of the meeting.

Documents and materials relating to an open session agenda item provided to the T-TSA Board of Directors less than 72 hours prior to
a regular meeting will be available for public inspection and copying at the Agency’s office, located at 13720 Butterfield Drive, Truckee,
CA.
